name: Touchscreen Tools
author: prezziej
description: Touchscreens and tablet posture on Omarchy: enable or disable the panel, bind it to the right monitor, correct or auto-follow its rotation, fold into tablet mode with the keyboard and touchpad out of the way, and see every contact drawn where your finger actually is.

barWidget.description: Enable, orient and visualise a touchscreen.

schema.label: Touchscreen
schema.description: Turn the panel off entirely. On a convertible this is the setting you actually reach for.

schema.label: Rotation
schema.description: Correct a digitizer mounted at a different rotation from the display. If touches land at 90 degrees to your finger, this is the setting.

schema.label: Auto-rotate display
schema.description: Follow the accelerometer: rotate the screen and the touchscreen together when you turn the machine.

schema.label: Tablet mode
schema.description: Turn off the keyboard and touchpad so a folded-back screen does not type on whatever it is resting against.

schema.label: Enter tablet mode automatically
schema.description: Off by default, and deliberately. This Yoga reports no SW_TABLET_MODE switch, so folded-back is INFERRED from orientation - and a laptop lying flat on a desk looks identical to a tablet lying flat. Turn this on if you want it to guess.

schema.label: Bound to monitor
schema.description: Which display this panel drives. Empty lets Hyprland decide, which is right until you plug in a second screen and your taps land on the wrong one.

schema.label: Contact HUD
schema.description: Draw each contact where it actually is on the glass. The fastest way to see whether a patch of an old panel has stopped responding.

schema.label: Show HUD from
schema.description: Fewest simultaneous contacts that summons the HUD. One shows every tap; raise it if that becomes noise.

schema.label: Off when the lid is shut
schema.description: A folded convertible presses its own screen against the base. Without this, that reads as a stream of phantom touches.

schema.label: Touchscreen
schema.description: Which panel to drive when more than one is attached. Empty prefers the built-in one.
